title: New Mechanism for the Apoptosis of Human Neuroblastoma Cells by the Interaction between Fluorene-9-Bisphenol and the G Protein-Coupled Estrogen Receptor 1.
authors: Liu, Xiuchang; Cheng, Zhi; Shang, Xueliang; Zhang, Huazhou; Liu, Xian; Pan, Wenxiao; Fu, Jianjie; Xue, Qiao; Zhang, Aiqian
one_liner_zh: 该文研究BHPF与G蛋白偶联雌激素受体GPER的相互作用及凋亡机制，对象为小分子-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，虽用MD模拟但与本课题TF-DNA结合建模无关。
abstract: Fluorene-9-bisphenol (BHPF) is an emerging contaminant. Presently, there is no report on its interaction with G protein-coupled estrogen receptor 1 (GPER). By using an integrated toxicity research scenario that combined theoretical study with experimental methods, BHPF was found to inhibit the GPER-mediated effect via direct receptor binding. Molecular dynamics simulations found that Trp272(6.48) and Glu275(6.51) be the key amino acids of BHPF binding with GPER. Moreover, the calculation indicated that BHPF was a suspected GPER inhibitor, which neither can activate GPER nor is able to form water channels of GPER. The role of two residues was successfully verified by following gene knockout and site-directed mutagenesis assays. Further in vitro assays showed that BHPF could attenuate the increase in intracellular concentration of free Ca(2+) induced by G1-activated GPER. Besides, BHPF showed an enhanced cytotoxicity compared with G15, indicating that BHPF might be a more potent GPER inhibitor than G15. In addition, a statistically significant effect on the mRNA level of GPER was observed for BHPF. In brief, the present study proposes that BHPF be a GPER inhibitor, and its GPER molecular recognition mechanism has been revealed, which is of great significance for the health risk and assessment of BHPF.
abstract_zh: 芴-9-双酚（BHPF）是一种新兴污染物。目前，尚无关于其与G蛋白偶联雌激素受体1（GPER）相互作用的报道。通过采用结合理论研究和实验方法的综合毒性研究场景，发现BHPF通过直接受体结合抑制GPER介导的效应。分子动力学模拟发现，Trp272(6.48)和Glu275(6.51)是BHPF与GPER结合的关键氨基酸。此外，计算表明BHPF是一种疑似GPER抑制剂，既不能激活GPER，也无法形成GPER的水通道。这两个残基的作用通过随后的基因敲除和位点定向突变实验得到了成功验证。进一步的体外实验显示，BHPF能够减弱由G1激活的GPER诱导的细胞内游离Ca(2+)浓度增加。此外，与G15相比，BHPF显示出增强的细胞毒性，表明BHPF可能是一种比G15更有效的GPER抑制剂。另外，观察到BHPF对GPER mRNA水平有统计学显著影响。总之，本研究提出BHPF是一种GPER抑制剂，并揭示了其GPER分子识别机制，这对BHPF的健康风险评估具有重要意义。
